description: Look up California contractor licenses on the CSLB (Contractors State License Board) public license check tool -- by license number, business name, personnel name, or HIS (Home Improvement Salesperson) registration number.

businessName.description: Business name to search for. CSLB matches from this name alphabetically forward (type fewer letters if you don't find the license, e.g. `Swinerton` instead of `Swinerton Builders Inc`).
businessName.title: Business name (mode=byBusinessName)

classificationFilter.description: Only emit license records that carry this CSLB classification. Records with no classification data always pass through. Ignored in mode=byHISNumber.
enumTitles: C-4 - Boiler, Hot Water Heating and Steam Fitting Contractor
C-5 - Framing and Rough Carpentry Contractor
C-6 - Cabinet, Millwork and Finish Carpentry Contractor
C-15 - Flooring and Floor Covering Contractor
C-20 - Warm-Air Heating, Ventilating and Air-Conditioning Contractor
C-28 - Lock and Security Equipment Contractor
C-31 - Construction Zone Traffic Control Contractor
C-32 - Parking and Highway Improvement Contractor
C-54 - Ceramic and Mosaic Tile Contractor
classificationFilter.title: Classification (trade) filter

hisNumber.description: Home Improvement Salesperson (HIS) registration number (1-8 digits; the site's "SP" suffix is added automatically).
hisNumber.title: HIS registration number (mode=byHISNumber)

includePersonnel.description: Attach the owners/officers/RMO/RME associated with each license (name, title, association date, classification). Adds a few extra requests per license.
includePersonnel.title: Include personnel (owners/officers)

licenseNumbers.description: CSLB contractor license numbers to look up (1-8 digits each; letters/punctuation are stripped automatically).
licenseNumbers.title: License numbers (mode=byLicenseNumber)

personnelFirstName.description: Optional first name to narrow a personnel name search.
personnelFirstName.title: Personnel first name (mode=byPersonnelName)

personnelLastName.description: Last name of a qualifying individual, owner, or officer associated with a license.
personnelLastName.title: Personnel last name (mode=byPersonnelName)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. CSLB's search form has no CAPTCHA and works reliably without a proxy; this is offered for extra resilience only.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

statusFilter.description: Only emit records whose current status matches. Records with no detectable status always pass through.
statusFilter.title: License / registration status filter

title: CSLB Contractor License Scraper Input
